nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Dawn rises like a blunt bayonet, cutting open the smog above the dead capital.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: You stand at the end of an old rail line. Ahead waits an energy tower that has slept for thirteen winters.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: At last, Comrade Commander. Today the city will learn your name.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: All I see is rubble, debt, and ghosts that never clocked out.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Rubble and debt are the same ledger. The question is who writes the final line.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She places a command chip in your palm. Three routes are etched in red steel.

choices.text: Route A: March to the Control Tower
Route B: Sweep the Old Dormitory Block
Route C: Gather intel at North Bank Market

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Only half the tower gate remains. The other half was melted into a twisted iron flower.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: This place once lit half a continent. Now it will illuminate the truth.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: The core chamber is still warm. Someone moved before us.

choices.text: Track the escape route on foot

nodes.speaker: Terminal
nodes.text: Final record: 'Plan S, Phase Two. Objective transferred to the North Bank sector.'

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: So they never abandoned it. Move. We regroup at the convergence point.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The footprints vanish at the stairwell bend. In their place lies a half-burned tactical map.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: North Bank. Red marker. Different trail, same destination.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Every room plate in the dormitory has been removed with surgical care, leaving only nail scars.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Someone wanted history erased, Comrade. That means history was dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: On the desk sits an unsent letter: 'If you read this, do not trust the public broadcast.'

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: The signature was torn off. Only one letter remains: S.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: A generator growls below like a sleeping beast sharpening its teeth.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Three hours of backup power. Enough for one operation and one miracle.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The market is officially dead, yet lamps still burn like eyes waiting for a late customer.

nodes.speaker: Broker
nodes.text: Information is expensive tonight. What will the young heroes pay?

nodes.speaker: Broker
nodes.text: Bold move. Your target will pass the Clocktower Plaza tonight with a portable reactor core.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We already know about Phase Two. Give coordinates now, or be buried with your secrets.

nodes.speaker: Broker
nodes.text: Fine. Clocktower Plaza. But listen, hero: that zone only speaks the language of fire.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Rain strikes the broken clock face. The hand is frozen at 03:17.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: This is it. The target is under the tower with a core that can wake the whole district.

choices.text: Infiltrate from the broken rear bridge

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Muzzle flashes carve white lines through the rain as you and Sovia push into the lower tower.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Core secured. The price was cruel, but the city will see light tonight.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: You cross the fractured steel bridge one breath at a time, darkness boiling below.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Silent capture complete. No alarms. Reactor integrity at one hundred percent.

nodes.speaker: Envoy
nodes.text: You want power, I want tomorrow. Give me safe passage and the core is yours.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Thirty minutes of ceasefire. North gate corridor. That is my final offer, Comrade.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: When the first streetlamp ignites, some cheer and some quietly weep.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: This is only Episode One. Next time, we light the entire city before sunrise.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: No cheers. No gunfire. Only the soft hum of current returning to old copper veins.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: A quiet victory is still a victory. We have many nights left to survive.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Core acquired, ceasefire active. Yet as the envoy departs, you spot a crest you know too well.

nodes.speaker: Sovia
nodes.text: Do not ask now. In the next chapter, I will tell you what Plan S truly means.
